title: [Feature Request] Add Session-Scoped Command Permissions
body:
**Bug Description**
Feature request. It is very common that I have temporary commands that need to be run in a workspace. When the command is executed, it is not auto-allowed, so Claude prompts. It asks if I would like to allow it once, allow it forever, or to decline. I would really like to allow for **session** because chances are I will never use that command again, and I really do not need it to be auto-allowed because it shows up in system instructions, which remind the model to use something that is not useful and just take up space. Remember command for session would be wonderful.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: vte-based
- Version: 2.0.8
- Feedback ID: 412373a2-e2e7-4eb4-90e9-cf3a483b8d67
